6530.html:
6530 dēvátā f. 'godhead, divinity' RV. [dēvá-¹]
    Pa. dēvatā- f. 'god', Pk. dēvayā- f.; Gy. eur. devel m. 'God', arm. leval (LM 353 wrongly < dēvakula-); Kal. deu 'divine being, fairy' < *del- (→ Kt. dēlu); P. devā m. 'goddess'; Or. diã 'deity, idol'; H. dewā m. 'deity', Si. deviyā.

434.html:
434 ápara 'posterior' RV., 'different, other' ŚBr. 2. *aparīya- Morgenstierne IIFL iii 3, 187. 3. áparam RV., °rám AV. 'again, moreover'.
    1. Pa. apara- 'other, next'; Pk. avara- 'latter, other'; Gy. eur. aver, wel. vavēr (with v- from definite article ov) 'other'; Kt. wari 'other'; Wg. uruṅä 'other, different'; Pr. warga 'other', Dm. warḗ, Kal. warḗg; Kho. (Lor.) hōr 'other, different', Shum. wəre 'other'; Sh. óra̯ 'except, apart from'; K. wōra- 'step-' e.g. w°-bĕñĕ 'stepsister'; ḍoḍ. hōrō 'other'; L. P. hōr 'other, more', WPah. paṅ. cur. hōr, bhal. hɔro; Ku. arko 'another', gng. hɔ̈̄r 'other, more'; N. aru 'other', arko 'another'; A. āru 'more', B. ār, āru; Or. āra 'other', āraka 'another one'; Bhoj. āwar (Ballia dial. awar), OAw. auru, H. aur, OMarw. aura; Si. avara 'hinder, western'.
    2. Paš. warī m. and f. 'other', Gaw. wāri; S. varī 'again, back'; — also here perh. Kt. Dm. Kal. Shum. forms above.
    3. Pa. aparaṁ 'further, besides'; Gy. wel. ō, ū 'and' Ḍ. o, Ash. ara, ra, Kho. ɔ̈̄r, o, S. ãũ, ãĩ, P. ar WPah. bhad. aur, Ku. ar, N. aru, ra, A. āru, u, B. ār Or. āur(i), āu, āhuri (< Sk. Pa. athāparam ?), OMth. ora, o, õ, ara, aru, āra, OAw. aru, lakh. au, a, H. aur, au, aru, OMarw. aru, ara, yara; G. ɔr 'also'.
    aparajá-, apararātrá-, *apararāṣṭra-, aparaśvas, aparānta-, *aparānna-, aparāpara-, *aparēndra-; kō'para-, dēśāpara-.
    *aparakṣati see vírakṣati.
    Addenda: ápara-: WPah.kṭg. (kc.) ōr, poet. hōr 'other', J. hōr; poet. hār 'other' (forms with h- poss. < athāparam); Garh. Ku. aur 'and'; — add MB. āara, āra 'more'.
